🇻🇪 Five months after the twin earthquakes in June, the Venezuelan government is making progress on debris removal and economic recovery in La Guaira 🚜 Five months after the twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela on June 24, 2026, authorities and crews from the Ministry of Public Works continue reconstruction efforts in the coastal state of La Guaira, where the seismic event caused the complete collapse of 189 buildings. 🧱 Using heavy machinery donated by China, operational teams have removed nearly 1,500,000 metric tons of debris throughout the coastal state, while continuing to conduct drone operations in areas such as Catia La Mar and the Belo Horizonte residential complex to recover victims before proceeding with the controlled demolition of structures.

Damascus is pushing back on Israel after the strike on a Hezbollah weapons shipment at the Syria-Lebanon border. A source close to the Syrian government told Kan News that IDF incursions in southern Syria are hampering efforts against Hezbollah. The source claims they give the pro-Iranian axis an excuse to return to Syria. Earlier this week, Syrian intelligence announced it foiled an arms transfer to Lebanon and arrested a suspect. The source also sees an opening for an Israel-Syria security agreement.
